POKEMART.Title: Poké Mart
POKEMART.NoMarts: No Poké Marts are open right now.
POKEMART.GMOnly: Only the GM can manage marts.
POKEMART.GMClosedNote: Closed to players. Only you can see this mart.
POKEMART.NoBuyers: None of your characters have a money field at {path}. Ask your GM to check the module settings.
POKEMART.DropHint: You can also drag items in from any Items compendium or the Items tab.
POKEMART.EmptyManager: No items yet. Add some from a compendium, or drag them into this window.
POKEMART.NoMartsManager: No marts yet. Create one to get started.
POKEMART.NoPacks: There are no Item compendiums in this world.
POKEMART.OnlyItems: Only Items can be added to a mart.
POKEMART.ItemOwned: Drag items from a compendium or the Items tab, not from a character sheet.

Errors.NoMoneyField: {actor} has no money field at {path}. Check the Poké Mart module settings.
Errors.NotEnough: Not enough money: this costs {total} and you have {money}.
Errors.ItemMissing: {item} no longer exists. Ask your GM to update the mart.
Errors.GrantFailed: Couldn't give {item} to {actor}. Your money was refunded.
Errors.RewardMissing: The free item {item} is no longer available, so it wasn't included.
Errors.RewardFailed: Couldn't give the free item {item}. Let your GM know.

moneyPath.Name: Money field
moneyPath.Hint: Where a character's money is stored on the actor. Characters without a number here can't shop.

pricePath.Name: Item price field
pricePath.Hint: Where an item's price is stored. Used as the starting price when you add an item to a mart; you can override it per mart.

quantityPath.Name: Item quantity field
quantityPath.Hint: Where an item's stack size is stored. Bought items stack onto existing ones using this. Leave empty if the system has none.

chatMessages.Name: Post purchases to chat
chatMessages.Hint: Post a chat message whenever someone buys something.

confirmPurchases.Name: Confirm before buying
confirmPurchases.Hint: Ask for confirmation before each purchase. This setting is per user.

descriptionPath.Name: Item description field
descriptionPath.Hint: Where an item's description is stored, shown when a player clicks an item in the shop. Common alternatives are tried if this is empty.

POKEMART.NothingToSell: You have nothing this mart will buy.
POKEMART.SellAny: Also buy items this mart doesn't sell (uses the item's own price)
POKEMART.SellOnlyHint: Players can only sell here. If this mart has no items listed, also tick the option to buy items it doesn't sell.
POKEMART.BogoEnabled: Free-item promotion (check out with enough items, get one free)
POKEMART.BogoBuyAtLeast: When the cart holds at least
POKEMART.BogoRepeat: Repeat for every multiple of that many items
POKEMART.BogoSame: The free item is the cheapest item in the cart
POKEMART.BogoDropHint: Drop the free item here, or choose it from a compendium.
POKEMART.BogoBannerSame: Check out with {n} or more items and get {count} more of your cheapest item free!
POKEMART.BogoBannerItem: Check out with {n} or more items and get {count}× {item} free!
POKEMART.CartEmpty: Your cart is empty. Add items from the list above.
POKEMART.BogoAlmost: Add {n} more item(s) to earn a free item!
